build_vit_b_16_model: build a ViT-B/16 vision transformer model with 12 layers and 768 hidden dimensions
build_vit_h_14_model: build a ViT-H/14 vision transformer model with 32 layers and 1280 hidden dimensions
create_vision_transformer: create a custom vision transformer with specified patch size, hidden dim, and number of layers
create_global_average_pooler: create a global average pooler module that averages patch embeddings and applies layer norm
run_vision_transformer_forward: run a vision transformer forward pass on input images with optional patch and attention masks
